_about: Single source of truth for timing. animation.py (cameras, events, captions, titles) and tools/voiceover.py read this file. Times are seconds from the start of the video at 30 fps.

scenes.name: THE MOUNTAIN
scenes.desc: A wide, slightly overcast morning over Pompeii: red-tiled roofs and the forum temple in the foreground, Vesuvius in the haze behind. The camera pushes in fast over the rooftops toward the mountain as a dark eruption column begins to climb from its summit.

shots.name: mountain
shots.camera: Wide establishing shot, 30 mm: from low over the rooftops south of the forum, a quick push-in toward Vesuvius that eases out.

scenes.edit: Fade up from black over 0.6 s. Low rumble, distant birds and town ambience; a deep impact as the column bursts upward.

scenes.name: LIFE IN POMPEII
scenes.desc: A Roman street at street level: plastered shopfronts with red dados, a tavern counter with jars, amphorae and pottery on a stall, hanging cloth, raised pavements and stepping stones, cart ruts. Citizens in tunics, stolas and cloaks walk both ways; a merchant lifts a jar; a man pulls a two-wheeled cart.

shots.name: street
shots.camera: Tracking shot, 28 mm, at eye height down the middle of the street, past people and stalls; foreground jars for depth.

scenes.edit: Hard cut on the first word. Street ambience: footsteps, voices (wordless murmur), cart wheels on stone, a hammer.

scenes.name: THE FIRST WARNING
scenes.desc: The forum. People stop and turn toward the north as the eruption column rises behind the temple. Ash begins to drift in the air; the light dims.

shots.name: warning
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder, 35 mm: behind a group of citizens, tilting up from them to the temple and the column beyond.

scenes.edit: Cut. The town murmur thins; a long low rumble grows; music starts a slow pulse.

scenes.name: THE SKY CHANGES
scenes.desc: The column spreads into an umbrella cloud over the town. Ash and pumice begin to fall. A close-up of pumice bouncing and gathering on terracotta roof tiles. Back to a wide view of the whole town under the spreading cloud.

shots.name: skyup
shots.camera: Low angle, 22 mm: up past the temple columns to the column and umbrella cloud.

shots.name: roof
shots.camera: Close-up, 50 mm: pumice landing and collecting on roof tiles; shallow depth of field.

shots.name: citywide
shots.camera: Wide, 30 mm, from outside the walls: the town beneath the spreading cloud; a slow push-in.

scenes.edit: Fast cuts on the beat. Pattering pumice on tiles, wind, a rising drone.

scenes.name: THE STREETS FILL
scenes.desc: The same street, now under falling pumice: a grey-white layer builds up over the paving, against doorsteps and over jars; people hurry through, heads covered. Visibility falls.

shots.name: fill
shots.camera: Backward tracking shot, 32 mm, at chest height, shallow depth of field; figures move toward and past the camera.

scenes.edit: Cut. Dense pumice patter, muffled footsteps, creaking roof timbers; a roof gives way off screen.

scenes.name: THE ERUPTION INTENSIFIES
scenes.desc: A wide view of Pompeii in near darkness beneath the eruption cloud. Thick ash, buildings fading into the haze, flickers of light inside the cloud (as Pliny described).

shots.name: dark
shots.camera: Wide, 26 mm, from high ground east of the town: a slow lateral move with the town small beneath the cloud.

scenes.edit: Cut. The music drops to a low drone; a deep, continuous roar; distant cracks with the flashes.

scenes.name: THE PYROCLASTIC CURRENTS
scenes.desc: From the plain south-east of the walls: the column collapses and a billowing, ground-hugging current of ash and hot gas pours down the slopes and across the fields, rolling over the walls and swallowing the town.

shots.name: surge
shots.camera: Wide, 24 mm, low over the fields: a slow push as the current advances and fills the frame.

scenes.edit: Silence for a beat before the cut, then a deep rushing roar that swells and fills everything.

scenes.name: POMPEII DISAPPEARS
scenes.desc: Overhead as the ash settles: the town lies under a grey blanket of deposits; only the tops of a few walls break the surface.

shots.name: aerial
shots.camera: Top-down aerial, 30 mm, slowly descending and rotating over the buried town.

scenes.edit: Slow cross-dissolve feel: the roar fades to wind and falling ash; a long low note.

scenes.name: CENTURIES PASS
scenes.desc: Time-lapse: days and nights flicker past, clouds race, rain, grass and then trees spread over the grey ground; the buried town is gone from view. A year counter runs from AD 79 to 1748.

shots.name: time
shots.camera: High aerial, 28 mm, a slow drift over the landscape with Vesuvius on the horizon.

scenes.edit: Wind, rain, birds returning; a gentle rising pad; the year counter ticks.

scenes.name: REDISCOVERY
scenes.desc: An excavation: a trench cut through the layers of soil, ash and pumice reveals a Roman street with its walls, stepping stones and jars. Workers dig with picks and shovels and carry baskets of spoil; the unexcavated ground rises behind them.

shots.name: dig
shots.camera: Slow crane down, 30 mm, from above the trench edge into the excavated street.

scenes.edit: Picks and shovels on soil, baskets, distant voices (wordless); the theme returns, warmer.

scenes.name: THE FINAL SHOT
scenes.desc: The excavated forum today in soft evening light: broken columns, the temple podium, Vesuvius beyond (echoing the opening shot). Final caption, fade to black.

shots.name: ruins
shots.camera: Slow push-in, 30 mm, between the columns toward the temple and the mountain.

scenes.edit: The final line; music resolves softly; fade to black under the final caption.

lines.text: One morning, this Roman city was still alive.
lines.tts: One morning, this Roman city was still alive.

lines.text: Pompeii: a busy town of shops, taverns and painted homes, beneath Mount Vesuvius.
lines.tts: Pompeii: a busy town of shops, taverns and painted homes, beneath Mount Vesuvius.

lines.text: Then, in 79 AD, the mountain erupted.
lines.tts: Then, in seventy-nine A.D., the mountain erupted.

lines.text: A column of ash and pumice rose an estimated thirty kilometres into the sky.
lines.tts: A column of ash and pumice rose an estimated thirty kilometres into the sky.

lines.text: For hours, pumice rained down on the town. Roofs began to collapse under the weight.
lines.tts: For hours, pumice rained down on the town. Roofs began to collapse under the weight.

lines.text: The sun disappeared. Day turned to darkness. Many fled. Others sheltered, and waited.
lines.tts: The sun disappeared. Day turned to darkness. Many fled. Others sheltered, and waited.

lines.text: Next morning, the column collapsed. Avalanches of scorching gas and ash swept through the city.
lines.tts: Next morning, the column collapsed. Avalanches of scorching gas and ash swept through the city.

lines.text: Pompeii vanished, under metres of volcanic debris.
lines.tts: Pompeii vanished, under metres of volcanic debris.

lines.text: And there it stayed. Hidden, and almost forgotten, for more than sixteen centuries.
lines.tts: And there it stayed. Hidden, and almost forgotten, for more than sixteen centuries.

lines.text: In 1748, the digging began. And Pompeii came back into the light.
lines.tts: In seventeen forty-eight, the digging began. And Pompeii came back into the light.

lines.text: The eruption that buried Pompeii also preserved it.
lines.tts: The eruption that buried Pompeii also preserved it.

titles.text: EXACT DATE DEBATED: AUGUST OR OCTOBER
AN EYEWITNESS, PLINY THE YOUNGER, LIKENED THE CLOUD TO A PINE TREE
UNDER UP TO ABOUT 6 M OF ASH AND PUMICE
ABOUT ONE-THIRD OF THE CITY IS STILL UNEXCAVATED
LOST IN 79 AD.|FOUND AGAIN, PIECE BY PIECE.
